NoSQLServer v0.50 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Warm runtime primary-key cache + physical row locators, and corrected SQL
single-row INSERT dispatch.

Critical dispatch fix
---------------------
NoSQLServerSQL~executeInsert previously sent every VALUES statement through
engine~insertMany(), even when the SQL contained exactly one tuple. That meant
the v0.48 single-row append method was not used by normal SQL/PyMySQL traffic.

v0.50 dispatches:
  one VALUES tuple  -> engine~insert()
  2+ VALUES tuples  -> engine~insertMany()

Runtime PK cache
----------------
- Per-process, per-root/table disposable cache.
- Built from authoritative storage when absent/stale.
- Single-column PRIMARY KEY only in this release.
- Maps PK signature to row + physical start line + physical line count.
- Carries table generation and is used only when generation-current.
- Single INSERT maintains the cache synchronously.
- PK-changing single-row UPDATE replaces the old cache key and locator.
- PK-equality DELETE removes the cache entry.
- Whole-file rewrite and compaction invalidate the cache.
- Restart simply rebuilds from authority; the cache is never authoritative.

Fast mutation eligibility
-------------------------
- single-column PRIMARY KEY
- equality predicate for UPDATE/DELETE
- no additional UNIQUE constraint requiring separate scan
- tombstone fast path enabled by storage size policy
- single physical line for UPDATE/DELETE locator mutation

SQL INSERT benchmark
--------------------
Direct engine, 5,000 separate ordinary SQL INSERT statements:

  v0.50: 500 rows   ~4.76 sec
  v0.50: 5,000 rows ~41.43 sec

The packaged v0.49 path could not complete the 500-statement comparison within
the execution ceiling because ordinary SQL still routed through insertMany and
whole-file rewrite.

A probe of the v0.50 journal confirms a one-tuple SQL INSERT records
newPhysicalLine and leaves the runtime PK cache generation-current.

Capabilities
------------
- RUNTIME_PK_CACHE
- PK_PHYSICAL_LOCATOR
- SQL_SINGLE_INSERT_APPEND
- existing append/tombstone/compaction capabilities remain

Regression evidence
-------------------
- v0.50 PK locator cache smoke: PASS
- v0.49 tombstone storage: PASS
- v0.48 append INSERT: PASS
- v0.47 VALUES source: PASS
- v0.46 ORDER BY optimizer: PASS
- v0.45 staged mutation graph: PASS
- FK/events/CTE/window/SQL-92/database_core gates: PASS
- Claude torture: 12/12 PASS
- Grok hell v1: 24/25 PASS, 0 wrong results
- Grok hell v2: 14/30 PASS, 0 wrong results
- rexxc: NoSQLServer.cls and all tests/*.rex compile cleanly
